question: Which of the following teams won the Indian Super League 2020-21?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai City FC**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **At the GMC Stadium in Goa, Mumbai City FC** defeated **ATK Mohun Bagan (ATKMB) 2-0 **to win** the Indian Super League **Winners Shield and the coveted AFC Champions League slot that comes with it.
 
• Mumbai and ATKMB tied for the first position with 40 points, but the former won due to a stronger head-to-head record.
 
• Mumbai City FC became the second Indian team to qualify for the AFC Champions League group stages. Mumbai City Football Team is an Indian professional football club based in Mumbai, Maharashtra, that participates in India's top flight, the Indian Super League.
 
• The club was created in August 2014, during the Indian Super League's debut season.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Kerala Blasters Football Team** is an Indian professional football club headquartered in Kochi, Kerala, that competes in the Indian Super League, India's highest level of football.
 
• **ATK Mohun Bagan FC** is a West Bengal-based Indian professional football team. The club competes in the Indian Super League, one of the country's premier football leagues.
 
• **NorthEast United FC** is an Indian professional football team headquartered in Guwahati, Assam, that participates in India's top division, the Indian Super League. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the Indian football system, the** Indian Super League** is the men's professional top-flight football league.
 
• All India Football Federation and their commercial partners Football Sports Development Limited are putting up the event.
 
• It is officially known as the Hero Indian Super League because of its sponsorship links with **Hero MotoCorp**.
